This site accompanies the Palatino PDF lecture notes. Each executable cell runs
R directly in the browser through WebR, so the classroom computer does not need
R installed and there is no server session to expire.

Use the navigation menu to open a chapter. Package downloads are declared
chapter by chapter to keep startup time manageable. The first cell on a page may
take a little longer while the WebR engine and that chapter's packages load.

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
cat("WebR is ready.  The mean of 1:10 is", mean(1:10), "\n")
```

For full-size causal-forest fits and bootstrap inference, use the included
GitHub Codespaces configuration. Those examples are intentionally smaller in
the browser companion so that they remain suitable for a live lecture.
